description: This file defines the Warning type and constants for HTTP warning codes, along with methods to generate header strings and string representations for warnings, specific to cache control in HTTP.

classes.name: Warning
classes.description: An integer type representing various HTTP warning codes.

methods.name: HeaderString
methods.description: Generates the Warning header string with agent and date information.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string description of the Warning code.
